description:
## About Our Brand and Products

Pulse Dance Shoes creates premium dance sneakers designed for dancers who want comfort, style, and performance. Our shoes are trusted by salsa, bachata, kizomba, line dancing, shuffle, West Coast Swing, dance fitness, and social dancers around the world.

Unlike traditional dance shoes, Pulse Dance Shoes combine the comfort of a sneaker with dance-specific performance features, making them suitable for both classes and social dancing.


We proudly serve customers across Australia, the United States, and internationally through our direct-to-consumer online store.

## What Makes Us Different

- Dance-engineered outsole designed for smooth movement and control

- Lightweight construction for all-night comfort

- Premium vegan microfiber upper

- Removable memory foam insole

- Suitable for a wide range of dance styles

- Stylish designs that look great both on and off the dance floor

- Free shipping available to customers

- Free returns available in key markets, reducing purchase risk

- Strong customer satisfaction and growing international community

- Multiple sizes including half sizes for a better fit

Our goal is simple: help dancers move with confidence while enjoying the comfort and support of a premium sneaker.

## How Affiliates Can Earn

- Earn 10% commission on every sale generated through your affiliate link

- Your audience receives 10% off every purchase

- 30-day cookie attribution period

- Competitive average order values

- Ongoing promotions and seasonal campaigns throughout the year

- Dedicated affiliate support

Whether you're a dance instructor, content creator, dance studio owner, event organiser, or social media influencer, Pulse Dance Shoes offers a strong opportunity to earn recurring commissions while promoting a product your audience will genuinely appreciate.

## How to Promote Us

Our best-performing affiliates typically promote Pulse Dance Shoes through:

- Dance class recommendations

- Social media content and reviews

- Dance tutorials and educational content

- Event sponsorships and workshops

- YouTube videos

- Instagram Reels and TikTok videos

- Email newsletters

- Affiliate blogs and product reviews

Authentic content showing real dancers using Pulse Dance Shoes consistently performs best.

## Other Information

Affiliate Commission: 10%

Customer Discount: 10%

Cookie Duration: 30 Days


Customer Benefits:

- Free shipping

- Free returns

- Premium customer support

- Secure checkout

- Worldwide shipping available

We're looking to partner with passionate dancers, instructors, creators, studios, and communities who want to introduce their audience to a premium dance sneaker designed specifically for dancing.
